author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices the keyboard map from low G to high G, notes that follow the words, two-part form and two hands, with a Shaker dance song.

classes.title: Between two G's
classes.goal: Find the low G and the high G the song lives between, and learn the first half.

mathTarget.parentLine: The whole song lives between a low G and a high G

classes.parentPrompt: Point to the low G, then the high G; let your child find both.
classes.childAction: Find low G and high G: the song lives between them.
classes.bridge: Low G on the left and high G on the right are the song's two walls.

intro.caption: Find the song's two walls
intro.parentCue: point to the low G, then the high G.

games.caption: From low G up to G
games.parentCue: Point to each key as it lights

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding where the song lives on the piano.

classes.title: When the words come down
classes.goal: Learn the next part and hear the notes go down when the words say 'come down'.

mathTarget.parentLine: When the words say 'come down', the notes go down too

classes.parentPrompt: Ask your child: the words say 'come down'. Where do the notes go?
classes.childAction: Play the line and feel your hand move down to the left.
classes.bridge: 'Come down' in the words is a walk down to the left on the keys.

intro.caption: The words and notes agree
intro.parentCue: ask your child where 'come down' goes.

games.caption: Come down where we ought to be
games.parentCue: Ask: did the notes go up or down?

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing notes follow the words.

classes.title: Two parts, one gift
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly: part one, a breath, then part two.

mathTarget.parentLine: Part one wanders; part two finds the place just right

classes.parentPrompt: Pause between the two parts and say: now we find the place just right.
classes.childAction: Play part one, take a breath, then play part two.
classes.bridge: Part one wanders; part two turns round and lands in the right spot.

intro.caption: Two parts, one song
intro.parentCue: pause and take a breath between the parts.

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a song in two parts.

classes.title: Turning round and round
classes.goal: Practise the turning running notes slowly, then a little faster.

mathTarget.parentLine: The notes turn round and round D, like dancers turning

classes.parentPrompt: Play it slowly; trace a small circle in the air as the notes turn.
classes.childAction: Play the turning notes slowly: C, D, E, D, C.
classes.bridge: The notes circle D like dancers turning round and round.

intro.caption: Turn, turn, round and round
intro.parentCue: trace a little circle as the notes turn.

games.caption: Turning round: C, D, E, D, C
games.parentCue: Trace a small circle in the air

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: quick running notes, slowly and evenly.

classes.title: The valley floor
classes.goal: Play one low left-hand note at the start of each bar.

mathTarget.parentLine: The left hand plays low notes, on the left side

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune; count bars aloud so your child plays one low note each.
classes.childAction: Play one low note with your left hand on each 'one'.
classes.bridge: The left hand plays the valley floor: one low note for each bar.

intro.caption: Down to the valley floor
intro.parentCue: count one at each new bar

games.caption: Same C, two houses
games.parentCue: Ask: which C is the valley floor?

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: low notes with the left hand.

classes.title: Two hands, turning together
classes.goal: Play the tune with one low left-hand note on each bar, very slowly.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each hand has its own job; they meet on the 'one'

classes.parentPrompt: Go very slowly; say 'one' each time both hands play together.
classes.childAction: Left hand on 'one', right hand plays the tune, slowly.
classes.bridge: Both hands land together on 'one', like two dancers stepping in.

intro.caption: Two hands, two jobs
intro.parentCue: go very slowly and stop while it's fun.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: giving each hand its own job.

classes.title: Dance along with the music
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music at full speed.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping your part going while the music moves on

classes.parentPrompt: Sit close and nod the beat; if a note is missed, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music. Missed notes are fine; keep going!
classes.bridge: The music is a turning dance; join in and keep turning.

intro.caption: Dance along with the music
intro.parentCue: nod the beat and keep going, whatever happens.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music, together.

classes.title: A simple gift for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy, smooth and gentle, then bow together.

mathTarget.parentLine: Playing smoothly and gently, the way the song feels

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; ask for gentle, flowing playing, then bow together.
classes.childAction: Play smooth and gentle for teddy, then take a bow.
classes.bridge: Gentle fingers glide like dancers, landing in the place just right.

intro.caption: Concert time for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: smooth, gentle playing, start to end.
